Id1.text: Columbia Records released Train's song titled, Mermaid, not the Warner Music Group, the groups record label.

Id2.text: The song Mermaid was written by the band Train, record labelled by Warner Music Group, which is on Columbia Records.

Id3.text: Mermaid by Train, whose record label is Warner Music Group, was released by Columbia Records.

Id4.text: The record label Columbia Records released the song Mermaid by the musical band Train. The band Train were signed to the record label Warner Music Group.

Id5.text: Warner Music Group is Train's record label, but their song Mermaid was released by Columbia Records.
